none: PAS NLM-211E22: Early Medieval Bracteate Pendant
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A gold bracteate dating to the 6th or 7th century AD. A gold uniface pendant, imitating a Byzantine or sub-Byzantine gold solidus, probably inspired by a solidus of Anastasius (491-518). The pseudo-inscription reads DNΛTTΛN_N_T┤T┌ΛNΛNCC (all Ns reversed). This is not a literate inscription but can most plausibly be derived from a literate inscription of Anastasius (DN ANASTASIVS PP AVG), although…
